rows.grounds: numeral specifying the quantity of thousands
locative plural indicating the vast number
compound denoting the loci or devices of birth
past passive participle describing the state of beings

items.question: What is the extent of torment endured within the manifold womb-mechanisms?
premises: The number of womb-mechanisms is specified as eighty-four thousand.
Beings are located within these womb-mechanisms.
Beings within these womb-mechanisms are tormented.
items.inference: Embodied existence entails suffering across an immense multiplicity of birth-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implicit and not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
